title: Airplane Concert in India Lands Crew in Trouble
main_content:
Five crew members for a chartered flight in India are suspended after permitting a Bollywood star to sing to the passengers.

The Jet Airways crew let singer Sonu Nigam use the plane’s announcement system in flight on January 4.

Jet Airways confirmed the suspensions after a video of the airplane performance appeared online.

Reports say passengers asked Nigam to sing for them once they realized he was on the flight from Jodhpur to Mumbai. He agreed.

He sang two of his popular songs over the plane’s announcement system. Passengers posted a video of the performance on social media.

The video went viral.

Government officials who learned of the incident asked the airline to take action.

The incident has led to strong arguments online both for and against the action.

questions.question: Who is Sonu Nigam?
options: A Bollywood film director known for his work in romantic comedies.
A popular singer celebrated for his contributions to Indian music.
An airline crew member with a passion for singing.
A politician known for advocating in the music industry.
questions.answer: A popular singer celebrated for his contributions to Indian music.

questions.question: What did Nigam do on the plane?
options: He entertained the passengers by giving a motivational speech.
He conducted a survey about passenger satisfaction.
He sang two of his popular songs over the plane’s announcement system.
He demonstrated the safety procedures to the passengers.
questions.answer: He sang two of his popular songs over the plane’s announcement system.

questions.question: What happened to the crew members?
options: They were promoted for their initiative in entertaining passengers.
They faced disciplinary action due to their unauthorized decision.
They received praise from passengers for enhancing their flight experience.
They were asked to apologize to the singer for the incident.
questions.answer: They faced disciplinary action due to their unauthorized decision.
